Environment · India

Heavy Rains Cause Disruption and Relief Across India

Several parts of India experienced significant rainfall, with Maharashtra's Mahabaleshwar recording its highest 24-hour rainfall in history. While some regions like Delhi and Gurugram faced severe waterlogging and disruptions, others, including parts of Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan, received monsoon relief. The recurring issue of urban flooding in Delhi has prompted a Public Interest Litigation seeking court-monitored reforms.
